title: QCC: Quantum Circuit Controller
description: A control plane for the quantum-classical interface. QCC brings declarative infrastructure, lifecycle orchestration, and standards-based observability to hybrid quantum-classical execution, treating quantum circuits and the backends that execute them as observable, schedulable resources. It is the proof-of-concept artifact of the MSc thesis "Interface between Quantum and Classical Computers" (Democritus University of Thrace, 2026).
